summary: Parametric, plugin and path geometry become generator-owned sketch geometry. A sketch generator is a graph relation record { id, kind: "generator", idPrefix, name?, construction, geometry } whose geometry is a rectangle, circle, slot, polygon, path or plugin shape, as a legacy profile's was, or a regular polygon directed by a line or axis. Only the record is stored. Every parse and every edit regenerates its members, real points, lines, arcs, circles and relations with ids <idPrefix>_<key>, keyed by their part of the shape and never by coordinates or sample order. A gear keys its members by tooth and part (t<k>_tip, t<k>_root, t<k>_flankL<n>s<i>, ...), a recipe by repetition and point (r<k>_v<i>), and a resampled flank's chords take new keys while its ends, the tip and the root keep theirs. Members are fixed in the solver and owned: an edit of one is refused, naming the generator, until it is detached, while free geometry may relate to them. A driving dimension whose geometry is all generated, with the origin or an axis at most, is refused with owned-sketch-generator, naming the generators whose inputs set it, and Dimension and Make driving offer only its reference form. Changing a generator's inputs or a parameter regenerates its members in the same undo step; members that leave take the user relations on them through the S6 relation remap, and a relation the remap would remove stays until the edit confirms it with removedRelationIds, as a trim does: the profile editor, the parameter editor and Finish of a consumed-sketch edit show what it removes before Apply, and one refusal covers every relation in every sketch a parameter regenerates. An agent's refusal stays bounded: it gives the version, the count and up to 64 IDs not yet confirmed, and the same edit resent at that version with them confirmed lists the next, so a removal of any size can be confirmed exactly. cad_get_context lists set-sketch-generator, detach-sketch-generator and every generated shape, regular-polygon among them, and says that inputs size generated geometry. A listed polygon's or path's entries keep their ids through insertions, deletions, reorders and edits in place, so an inserted vertex reshapes only the edge it splits; entries changed where others are also inserted or removed take fresh ids unless the edit gives its own, so the relations on the ones they replace are confirmed, never moved to a guessed vertex. Saved legacy profiles load and stay editable, but every new shape is a generator, and an edit that gives a sketch a new saved profile fails with legacy-sketch-profile. A region whose boundary is exactly one generator's closed outline reads as the profile that generator replaces did, under its name and kind; any other closed loop reads as a path contour. A generated sketch is shown, checked and captured without starting the sketch solver, and one check generates each generator once.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output. CAD documents gain an additive sketch relation kind, generator, and a sketch that holds a graph is written with schemaVersion 2 instead of 1. Documents saved before this release load unchanged: their saved profiles stay profiles and stay editable. New shapes, plugin instances and agent-inserted shapes are stored as generator records, which older builds of the app cannot open. A region reference to a generated void gains graphContours. Profile dimensions on a generator fail with the new code generator-sketch-dimension, whose message names the input that sets that size. A generated rectangle with a hole highlights its five edges one by one, where its saved profile highlighted two outlines.

checklist.schema: Additive CAD document change: the sketch graph relation union gains generator { id, kind, idPrefix, name?, construction, geometry }, whose geometry is a CAD profile geometry or a regular polygon { x, y, radius, sides, directionId }. A polygon's or path's geometry may also store ids, one integer entry id per point or segment, written only when they differ from the indices after an insertion, deletion or reorder; they key its members so the entries kept keep their ids. The stored form holds the record alone; parsing regenerates its members and refuses carried members that differ, naming the generator (stale-sketch-generator). A sketch with a graph is written with schemaVersion 2. The edit schema gains set-sketch-generator and detach-sketch-generator, and set-sketch-generator and set-parameter gain optional removedRelationIds, the trim's confirmation field. Saved legacy profiles, UPID, post schema, machine packages, saved revisions, storage and journals are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1, saved-job engine remains 3 and CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation, input-version or WebMCP guard change. Initial CAD discovery is 51,124 of its 51,200 UTF-8 bytes. cad_construct_path's description now says to insert its geometry as a path generator and detach it to keep plain lines and arcs. New error codes: legacy-sketch-profile, generator-sketch-dimension, invalid-sketch-generator, owned-sketch-generator, stale-sketch-generator, unconfirmed-sketch-generator-removals (with details.relationIds, and details.relations giving each relation's sketchId) and stale-sketch-generator-removals.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Rectangle, circle, slot, polygon, path and plugin tools create generators; the profile editor and plugin panel edit a generator's inputs as they edited a profile, and Detach turns its members into ordinary sketch geometry.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, wrapper, numbering or controller-file change. Solids, sections and exports built from a generator match those built from the legacy profile it replaces, in every legacy kind and through a save and load.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Installed plugin packages are unchanged and keep their API; a plugin instance generates through the pinned package as before. Browser cache and folder adapters store the stored form, the generator records without members, and load documents saved before this release unchanged.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest, build, lint, ui:check, check-release and each affected Playwright spec on its own, run before review is requested.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch shapes, gears and imported paths become generators: shapes you can resize from their inputs that stay real sketch geometry.
changes: New rectangles, circles, slots, polygons, paths and plugin shapes such as gears are generators. Their edges and points are sketch geometry you can relate free geometry to, and their inputs, numbers or parameter expressions, size and place them.
Changing a generator's inputs or parameters regenerates its geometry in one undo step. Teeth, sides and repetitions that remain keep their relations.
When a change would remove relations on geometry a shape no longer has, the shape editor, the parameter editor and Finish of a sketch edit list them and ask before applying.
Edit shape, on a selected shape's edge or point, opens its inputs, including a regular polygon's centre, radius, number of sides and direction line.
Detach turns a generator's geometry into ordinary lines, arcs and points.
Saved profiles load and stay editable as before.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Parts with new generator shapes need this version or later to open.
